mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_conversation (id, conv_type, biz_key, conv_name, conv_avatar, owner_id, last_msg_id, last_msg_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{convType}, #{bizKey}, #{convName}, #{convAvatar}, #{ownerId}, #{lastMsgId}, #{lastMsgTime}, '0', #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, conv_type AS convType, biz_key AS bizKey, conv_name AS convName, conv_avatar AS convAvatar, owner_id AS ownerId, last_msg_id AS lastMsgId, last_msg_time AS lastMsgTime, del_flag AS delFlag, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_chat_conversation WHERE biz_key = #{bizKey} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, conv_type AS convType, biz_key AS bizKey, conv_name AS convName, conv_avatar AS convAvatar, owner_id AS ownerId, last_msg_id AS lastMsgId, last_msg_time AS lastMsgTime, del_flag AS delFlag, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_chat_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id AS id, c.conv_type AS convType, c.conv_name AS convName, c.conv_avatar AS convAvatar, c.last_msg_id AS lastMsgId, c.last_msg_time AS lastMsgTime, m.unread_count AS unreadCount, (SELECT m2.content FROM t_chat_message m2 WHERE m2.id = c.last_msg_id) AS lastContent, (SELECT m2.msg_type FROM t_chat_message m2 WHERE m2.id = c.last_msg_id) AS lastMsgType, peer.user_id AS peerId, pu.nickname AS peerName, pu.avatar AS peerAvatar, pu.username AS peerUsername FROM t_chat_member m JOIN t_chat_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_chat_member peer ON peer.conversation_id = c.id AND peer.user_id <> #{userId} AND peer.del_flag = '0' AND c.conv_type = 1 LEFT JOIN t_user pu ON pu.id = peer.user_id AND pu.del_flag = '0' WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY c.last_msg_time DESC, c.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_member (id, conversation_id, user_id, member_role, last_read_msg_id, unread_count, join_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{memberRole}, #{lastReadMsgId}, #{unreadCount}, #{joinTime}, '0', #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id AS conversationId, user_id AS userId, member_role AS memberRole, last_read_msg_id AS lastReadMsgId, unread_count AS unreadCount, join_time AS joinTime, del_flag AS delFlag, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_chat_member WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT id, conversation_id AS conversationId, user_id AS userId, member_role AS memberRole, last_read_msg_id AS lastReadMsgId, unread_count AS unreadCount, join_time AS joinTime, del_flag AS delFlag, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_chat_member WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(unread_count), 0) FROM t_chat_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_message (id, conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, msg_type, content, attachment_id, read_flag, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{attachmentId}, 0, '0', #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT msg.id AS id, msg.conversation_id AS conversationId, msg.sender_id AS senderId, msg.msg_type AS msgType, msg.content AS content, msg.attachment_id AS attachmentId, att.original_name AS attachmentName, att.file_size AS attachmentSize, att.content_type AS attachmentContentType, msg.read_flag AS readFlag, msg.create_time AS createTime, sender.nickname AS senderName, sender.avatar AS senderAvatar FROM t_chat_message msg LEFT JOIN t_user sender ON sender.id = msg.sender_id AND sender.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_chat_attachment att ON att.id = msg.attachment_id AND att.del_flag = '0' WHERE msg.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND msg.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY msg.create_time DESC, msg.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT msg.sender_id AS senderId, sender.nickname AS senderName, sender.avatar AS senderAvatar, COUNT(*) AS unreadCount, MAX(msg.create_time) AS lastTime, (SELECT latest.content FROM t_chat_message latest WHERE latest.sender_id = msg.sender_id AND latest.receiver_id = #{userId} AND latest.read_flag = 0 AND latest.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY latest.create_time DESC, latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastContent, MIN(msg.conversation_id) AS conversationId FROM t_chat_message msg JOIN t_user sender ON sender.id = msg.sender_id AND sender.del_flag = '0' WHERE msg.receiver_id = #{userId} AND msg.read_flag = 0 AND msg.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY msg.sender_id, sender.nickname, sender.avatar ORDER BY lastTime DESC
SELECT conversation_id FROM t_chat_message WHERE attachment_id = #{attachmentId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
